sentences.en: Google and library databases jumble different forms of information together.
sentences.zh: 谷歌和图书馆数据库会将不同形式的信息混杂在一起。

sentences.en: There is a jumble sale on Saturday in the Church Hall.
sentences.zh: 星期六在教堂大厅有一个旧物义卖。

sentences.en: Jumble sales are a real treasure trove for antiques.
sentences.zh: 旧物义卖是寻找古董的宝库。
